pairs.evidence: packages/czech-civic-data/README.md:9 The package's published Czech copy opens each quotation with the Czech low quote U+201E (byte-checked with od) and closes it with an ASCII double quote. That is the mismatched pair CS-QUOTES names as a defect, and the line above (README.md:8) also puts an em dash (U+2014) in Czech prose, against CS-DASH.

techniques.evidence: packages/czech-civic-data/README.md:9 „ is closed by ASCII " instead of U+201C, twice on this line (CS-QUOTES). README.md:8 also has ' — včetně' (U+2014) in Czech prose (CS-DASH).

packages/czech-civic-data/README.md:65 The package's own Czech gloss of the vote codes describes an MP of unknown gender in bare masculine past tense and participles (přihlášen, nestiskl; line 64 has 'stiskl X'). The code label itself (nehlasoval) is the publisher's term, but the parenthetical gloss is the package's own text.

packages/czech-civic-data/README.md:3 The Czech copy is impersonal description (infinitive title, third person). It never addresses the reader, so it does not have to choose between vykání and tykání.
